_comment: fm482 (sim-video-couple-speed-v1): MERGE into the mission runtime-config. Both switches are default-off (absent => byte-identical). arrival_xy_hysteresis_m latches the couple-standoff XY capture so the turn-to-yaw finishes instead of dithering on the tolerance circle (warm runs 347-356: ~700 s wall per run). coupled_creep_escape keeps a forward creep (arc clamped to the 1.5 m min turn radius) inside the |v|<0.06 m/s odometry-noise band instead of refusing on measured_turn_radius (runs 352/355: 121 s livelock). When on, each is named in the couple/outbound stage evidence (couple_arrival_mode / outbound_brake_mode) and so in the walkthrough-cut captions. Proof: scripts/check_couple_speed.py.

_optional_couple_standoff_tolerance._comment: Top-level config['couple_standoff_tolerance']; leave UNSET (xy 0.05 m / yaw 0.08 rad). The fine-dock capture bound (check_couple_speed A3) is xy <= 0.08 m for |yaw| <= 0.16 rad, xy <= 0.07 m up to 0.35 rad; keep xy + hysteresis inside it.
